etsy.title: Crochet Basket Pattern PDF With Handles, Round Storage Basket, Moss Stitch, Chunky Yarn Basket, English German Hungarian
etsy.description:
A sturdy round basket with handles for the bathroom, the nursery or your yarn stash: flat base, a back-loop turning round, moss-stitch sides and built-in handles. About 4 hours.

• Skill level: intermediate (6/6 in our series)
• Size: about 18 cm (7 in) across, 12 cm (4.75 in) tall
• Hook: 6 mm
• Yarn: about 250 g chunky cotton or T-shirt yarn, or worsted held double
• Tip for a bigger basket included

PDF PATTERN ONLY – not the finished item. Instant download in English (US terms + UK table), German (Deutsch) and Hungarian (magyar).
Includes a stitch chart (symbol diagram), a finished-shape sketch with measurements and a symbol key.
New pattern: the first image is the stitch chart; a maker-tested photo will be added.
For personal use and small-batch handmade sales with credit to AureliaVenn. Please don't share or resell the pattern.

Written with the help of AI tools; stitch counts checked row by row.
